note: Illinois Election Code section 2A-1.2 places the election of the Chicago mayor at the consolidated election in odd-numbered years, so no mayoral election falls in an even-numbered year. The Board website returned HTTP 403 to automated requests, so its election index could not be opened. Proclamation PDFs on app.chicagoelections.gov were opened instead.

Chicago mayoral elections occur at the consolidated election in odd-numbered years on a four-year cycle. The Board of Election Commissioners proclamations show the cycle as 2011, 2015, 2019 and 2023, so this year has no mayoral election. The next regular election is in 2027.
